'''2001 Vancouver Open''' (Decipher's listing: '''Hyperlight Open Championships''') was a Star Wars CCG Open championship in Vancouver, British Columbia, on 12 August 2001. It was one of the twelve World Championship Open Qualifiers Decipher scheduled between 1 June and 4 September 2001, sponsored by Hyperlight Enterprises.<ref name="dec-oq">[https://starshipexcelsior.com/othersites/stccg1e/rules_archive/decipher/Z_KLAUSERS_ARCHIVE/Worlds2001.htm A Players' Guide to the World Championship Open Qualifiers], Decipher (2001). Copy on Starship Excelsior.</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 12 August 2001, 10 a.m.<ref name="dec-oq" />
* '''Site:''' Renfrew Community Center, Room 204, 2929 E. 22nd Ave., Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada<ref name="dec-oq" />
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]

The event was played before [[Coruscant (expansion)|Coruscant]] was tournament legal.<ref name="dt-18439">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/18439 Vancouver Open 4th place DS], DeckTech (Keith "Gen" Watabayashi, 19 August 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/18439/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/18439/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

Watabayashi wrote that his Dark list was "card-for-card what I played at Vancouver" and that it went 3–0 there; its record over the summer was 11–1, the one loss to Charles Hickey. He also wrote a tournament report, "The Vancouver Open", which has not been found.<ref name="dt-18439" />
